visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two women, one in a pink suit with pink tinted glasses and the other in a white top and denim skirt, walk together outdoors along a paved path with lush green trees in the background. The woman in pink gestures with her hands, pointing at various things while speaking animatedly. (2) Inside a brightly lit cafe with modern wood-paneled decor, a man with pink hair and a white mesh shirt enters. He stands before the two women who are now seated at a white table. He introduces himself with a polite smile and slight bow. (3) Two more men join the lineup. One wears a blue striped shirt with a red heart patch, and the other a white t-shirt featuring a black cat graphic. They look at the women and smile while standing in a row behind a wooden counter. (4) A fourth man in a plain white t-shirt with a small dog logo enters the frame. He bows deeply towards the camera and begins his self-introduction, displaying a confident and friendly facial expression. (5) The woman in pink suit stands up and interacts closely with the men. She points at their facial features and leans in towards the fourth man. She then holds his arm tightly and leads him away from the table. (6) The younger woman sits alone at the table, looking bewildered with her mouth open. The camera pans to show the remaining three men standing together, pointing towards the exit and laughing heartily at the situation.
